subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained.”?
options: Others simply wanted to try something new.
Jack wanted to stand in the back.
Most students wanted to sit farther back.
Everyone laughed, and Nancy wanted to quit.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Others simply wanted to try something new.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained. Jack wanted to stand in the back.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Most students wanted to sit farther back.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained. Jack wanted to stand in the back.」，答案為「Jack wanted to stand in the back.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Jack wanted to stand in the back.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
